projects.title: fulcrum
projects.description: fulcrum is Software-As-A-Service (SaaS) product that enables anyone, anywhere to build any mobile data collection application for any reason and deploy it to any number of mobile devices (smartphones) around the world, in any language, in a matter of minutes.  Data is collected and sent back to the fulcrum mapping servers in real-time for geocoding and geotagging for additional analysis.  fulcrum is also a platform for others to build mobile collection apps for field-work and then to privately label as their own.
